raw_text: BREAKING: Drone footage from LoC sector shows Indian Army soldiers crossing into Pakistani territory near Hajipir Pass. Multiple soldiers visible in thermal view advancing across the ceasefire line. This is a clear violation of the 2003 ceasefire agreement. Forwarded from verified sources on the ground.
clean_text: Drone footage allegedly showing Indian Army soldiers crossing the Line of Control near Hajipir Pass. Multiple soldiers visible in thermal imagery advancing across the ceasefire line.
